steps.what: List stored courses on the learning record
Identify training opportunities for sustainability employees
Note educational development opportunities for volunteers

outputs: filed copy of signed training note v1

tasks.design: A job lists courses already on the learning record in {LMS}. The officer identifies educational, training, or other development opportunities for sustainability employees or volunteers. The list is courses, not a score of a person. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course options were collected by asking each person, which can become a performance watch.
tasks.enabler_now: The course catalogue is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The right opportunity still depends on the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides which opportunity to offer.
tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week with the people, not scoring them.

reach.task: Open only the course the note names

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] says staff performance monitoring is high-risk, Digest [S14] limits a solely automated decision, and Digest [S15] requires works-council consent for performance tools, so this design does not score employees or volunteers.
The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Configure the existing course list before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether volunteers can use the same courses.
research_questions: How often a needed course is not on the record.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining identification time is still the officer with the people.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the course list is thin. The high end assumes the course list is already stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored environmental incidents and amounts
Record the environment risk the officer accepts

outputs: filed copy of signed risk assessment v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored environmental incidents and amounts in {ERP}. The officer conducts the risk assessment related to sustainability and the environment, and decides which risk is accepted. A later job files the signed assessment in {DOCS}. A model does not accept the risk, and the assessment is not a decision about a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Incident lists were rebuilt before each assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: The incidents and amounts are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Accepting a risk still depends on the site.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides which risk stands.

ambition.what: Assess a risk the week the incident rows are posted.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the risk, not on rebuilding the list.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.
The executive digest says a recurring review is a dashboard on the ledger, and Digest [S2] says unprepared data gives inaccurate answers, so every cited number is checked against stored rows.

assumptions: The officer accepts or refuses the risk.
No decision about a person is produced.
unknowns: Which sites are in the assessment.
Who else must accept a risk.
research_questions: How often an incident has no stored amount.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining assessment time is still the officer's judgement.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes incident rows are thin. The high end assumes incident rows are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The sustainability officer spends the week on the strategy, the risk, and the signed text. A total from stored rows and filing that text can move. No model approves a project or scores a person.
reach: A supplier receives only the report version the officer signed.
A project lead starts only from the proposal the officer approved.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no row in the ledger.
Check whether a reporting duty applies before a report is called a filing.
role.ambitious_version: A signed impact report can go out the same week, and the officer still holds the text.
